text:
Maya Tran: Quick flag — during today's enrollment import we got 3 employees flagged as 'eligibility exception: prior plan overlap'. Need manager attestations or People Ops signoff before we process retroactive enrollments. Doc with IDs: https://redwood-internal/ops/enroll/EXCEPTIONS-2026-03-23 (internal only).

BenefitsBot: Automated notice created for 3 users: user_1987, user_2044, user_2099. Next action: manager attest or People Ops override.

Eli Kapoor: Thanks — adding to the tracker now. Can managers attest by EOD? I will only run manual overrides with an explicit manager email + attached signed ack.

Sasha Li: @Aaron can you confirm for user_2044? That one is a contractor->FTE conversion from last week.

Aaron (HR Manager): Confirmed for user_2044. Will send signed attestation email by 17:00 and upload to HRIS. Retroactive contribution start should be 2026-03-01 per payroll note.

Maya Tran: Great. For the other two, @Sasha can you ping their hiring managers and ask them to use the attestation template below? Also FYI — new manager benefits onboarding training is required before we accept exceptions. Link: /learning/benefits-onboard :memo:

Sasha Li: On it. Quick Q — where do we store the signed attestation PDFs? Google Drive or HRIS?

Eli Kapoor: Upload to HRIS -> Documents -> Enrollment Exceptions. If you upload manually, post the filename here so I can pick it up. Filename format we use: exceptions/{employee_id}/{YYYY-MM-DD}_manager_attestation.pdf

BenefitsBot: Follow-up reminder scheduled: 48h if no manager attest. :alarm_clock:

Aaron (HR Manager): Uploaded user_2044/2026-03-23_manager_attestation.pdf to HRIS. Email sent to benefits@redwood with the signed note.

Maya Tran: Thanks — once we have both remaining manager acks I'll run the override. If managers want a copy-paste, use this script: 

``
I confirm [employee name] is eligible due to [reason]. I approve retroactive enrollment from [date].
- [manager name]
``

Maya Tran: Closing loop: Sasha, pls ping here when the other two are uploaded and Eli I'll coordinate the override window (will schedule outside payroll cutoff). :thumbsup:
